dcsb.title: Edge-Cloud Collaborated Object Detection via Difficult-Case Discriminator
evidence: Qiu et al. official comparison implementation baseline.py::fit_dcsb
faithful: difficult label from cloud count greater than edge count at confidence 0.5
adaptations: exact observed-breakpoint search replaces potentially non-terminating binary search
continuous DCSB-Score-Adapted is added only for common budget evaluation
current frozen detectors and dataset-specific category spaces are used

oric_moric.title: Optimizing Edge Offloading Decisions for Object Detection
faithful: ORIC contextual mAP reward and context-size normalization
adaptations: fit-internal holdout selects training epoch before all-fit retraining
COCO-format top-left xywh boxes are converted to normalized center-xywh features used by the official code
current final evaluation uses Official AP@[.5:.95] and actual request bytes
SharedAction is a controlled payload diagnostic and not part of the original method
oric_moric.known_source_discrepancy: The paper defines MORIC as an empirical CDF. The public training script assigns ordinal ranks to fit ties but uses a right-continuous CDF on validation. This reimplementation follows the paper equation and gives tied rewards equal CDF values.
